| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `deletionPolicy` | string |  | `Orphan` keeps the external resource when the managed resource is deleted. Without `Delete` in `managementPolicies` the resource is always orphaned. One of `Delete`, `Orphan`. Default `Delete`. |
| `forProvider` | object | yes | `spec.forProvider`: the generated API fields plus references and credentials. |
| `forProvider.pattern` | string | yes | Pattern to match incoming requests against. [Learn more](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/configuration/routing/routes/#matching-behavior). |
| `forProvider.script` | string |  | Name of the script to run if the route matches. |
| `forProvider.zoneRef` | object |  | A reference to another managed resource: a namespaced resource in the namespace of the resource holding the reference, or a cluster-scoped one. |
| `forProvider.zoneRef.name` | string | yes |  |
| `managementPolicies` | []string |  | Actions the controller may take. `["*"]` (default) allows all; `["Observe"]` only reads (import without management). `Observe` is always required. Default `["*"]`. |

- `forProvider`: zoneRef cannot be removed once set
